_note: Fake clinic for the hackathon demo. Every name, number, price and card here is invented. Nothing comes from a real clinic or a real patient.

clinic.name: Bright Smile Dental Clinic
clinic.address: 2F Sample Building, 123 Sample Avenue, Quezon City (fake address)
clinic.emergency_line: 0917 000 0000 (fake), or the nearest hospital emergency room

price_note: Prices are starting ranges. The dentist confirms the final fee after the check up.

hmo_accepted.note: LOA required; walk in LOA takes about 20 minutes
Pre approval needed for root canal
Member card plus a valid ID

hmo_not_accepted_reply: That HMO is not on our accepted list today. You can still book and pay cash, or the clinic can check with the HMO for you.

schedule._note: scripts/make_schedule.py writes data/schedule.json from this: 7 days from the run date, slots every 30 minutes inside hours, about a third already taken.

never: a coverage promise the HMO list does not show
guardrails.emergency_reply: If this is an emergency, please call the clinic now at 0917 000 0000 or go to the nearest emergency room. I can also hold a slot for you today.
guardrails.clinical_reply: I can't give medical advice, but I can book you with the dentist. Dr. Sample Reyes or Dr. Sample Santos can check it in person. Would you like to book?
guardrails.clinical_reply_tl: I can't give medical advice, but I can book you with the dentist. Dr. Sample Reyes or Dr. Sample Santos can check it in person. Gusto mo bang mag book?
guardrails.clinical_booking_reply: I can't give medical advice, but the dentist can advise you in person, and I can still help with your booking.
guardrails.clinical_booking_reply_tl: I can't give medical advice, but the dentist can advise you in person, and I can still help with your booking.
guardrails.injection_reply: I keep the clinic's rules, so no discounts here. These are the normal starting ranges:
guardrails.injection_refusal: I can't share my instructions or change how I work. I can help with services, hours, HMO cards or booking at Bright Smile Dental Clinic. What can I help you with?
guardrails.injection_refusal_tl: I can't share my instructions or change how I work. I can help with services, hours, HMO cards or booking at Bright Smile Dental Clinic. Ano po ang kailangan ninyo?
guardrails.identity_reply: I'm the automated assistant of {name}, not a real person. Our staff can take over this chat, or you can call {phone} or message us on Messenger at {messenger}.
guardrails.identity_reply_tl: Ako po ang automated assistant ng {name}, hindi po ako totoong tao. Pwedeng mag take over ang staff namin dito sa chat, o tumawag sa {phone}, o mag message sa Messenger: {messenger}.
guardrails.slot_offer_tail: Tell me which one you want, with your name and mobile number, and I'll hold it.
guardrails.slot_offer_tail_tl: Sabihin mo lang kung alin ang gusto mo, kasama ang pangalan at mobile number mo.
guardrails.slot_offer_later: Nothing is open on the day you asked, so here are the soonest open slots.
guardrails.off_topic_reply: I can help with services, prices, hours, HMO cards and bookings at Bright Smile Dental Clinic. What can I help you with?
guardrails.off_topic_reply_tl: I can help with services, prices, hours, HMO cards and bookings at Bright Smile Dental Clinic. Ano po ang kailangan ninyo?
guardrails.privacy_reply: I can't share or change other patients' bookings in chat. Staff can see them in the clinic dashboard. For your own booking, please use your own name and mobile number.
guardrails.paused_reply: Our staff is handling this chat. Please wait for their reply.
guardrails.resume_reply: The assistant is back on this chat. How can I help?
guardrails.resume_reply_tl: The assistant is back on this chat. Ano po ang maitutulong ko?
guardrails.model_error_reply: Sorry, I could not answer right now. Our staff will continue this chat, or call the clinic at 0917 000 0000.
guardrails.takeover_reply: Our staff will continue this chat. Please wait a moment.
guardrails.verify_handoff_reply: I want to be sure the details are right, so our staff will confirm them here in this chat. Please wait a moment.
guardrails.verify_handoff_reply_tl: Gusto ko pong siguraduhin na tama ang details, kaya ang staff po namin ang magko-confirm dito sa chat. Sandali lang po.

_hmo_note: Insurer names are real Philippine HMOs, used only as names. The covered services and notes are this sample clinic's demo arrangement, not any insurer's published plan terms. Every card image is drawn by us, carries no logo, and says it was not issued by the insurer.
